onboarding.title: A little about you
onboarding.subtitle: Helps us understand who visits the river. Takes five seconds.

slides.title: Welcome to the Kamogawa
slides.body: This map shows what's happening on the riverbank right now, live.

slides.title: Exclamation marks
slides.body: Tap a ! marker to see the activity happening there and who's part of it.

slides.title: Duck marks
slides.body: Tap a duck to browse duck photos and find nearby stamp spots.

slides.title: Join in
slides.body: Post your own activity, or add on to someone else's -- everyone's welcome.

slides.title: Collect stamps
slides.body: Scan the QR code at a real duck spot along the river to earn a stamp.
